title: Official portal: pay your entry authorisation fee
scenario: A search result leads you to a professional-looking site offering to process your travel entry authorisation for a service fee well above the government's own price, before your trip.

answers.A: Go to the government's own official domain directly to apply at the correct price.
answers.B: Pay through the site since it looks official and saves time.
answers.C: Pay through the site, and also upload a passport photo for 'fast processing'.

explanation: Unofficial sites that rank highly in search results routinely charge a large markup for a form you can file yourself, directly on the government's real domain, for less.
proTip: Type the government domain in yourself rather than trusting a search-ad result.
